monster.defeatQuote: Combinations of [1, 5, 10, 25] coins totaled exact change!

description: Given an integer `target`, return all combinations of coin denominations `[1, 5, 10, 25]` that sum up to `target`. Each coin may be used an unlimited number of times.
solutionCode:
def combinationSumCoins(target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    coins = [1, 5, 10, 25]
    res = []
    def backtrack(idx, rem, path):
        if rem == 0:
            res.append(list(path))
            return
        for i in range(idx, len(coins)):
            if coins[i] > rem: break
            path.append(coins[i])
            backtrack(i, rem - coins[i], path)
            path.pop()
    backtrack(0, target, [])
    res.sort(key=lambda c: (len(c), c))
    return res

def combinationSumCoins(target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    coins = [1, 5, 10, 25]
    res = []
    def backtrack(idx, rem, path):
        if rem == 0:
            res.append(list(path))
            return
        for i in range(idx, len(coins)):
            if coins[i] > rem: break
            path.append(coins[i])
            backtrack(i, rem - coins[i], path)
            path.pop()
    backtrack(0, target, [])
    res.sort(key=lambda c: (len(c), c))
